prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Production animation asset: the CLEAN STATIONARY BACKPLATE of this exact approved level-3 spring nest. The supplied PNG is the edit target and exact design authority, not loose inspiration.
Create ONE complete transparent sprite, same camera, same original canvas registration and scale. At 512x512-equivalent coordinates preserve the original outer silhouette x28..486 y207..449. Retain the original large empty transparent upper margin. Keep every pale aquamarine stone basin and outer turquoise watery rim, two stepped stone channels, wooden sluice and bronze lever on the right, front birth pool, and all stone waterwheel supports in their original locations and original painterly outline and shading.
REMOVE ONLY separately animated components and paint the surfaces they were hiding:
1. Remove the wooden waterwheel's rotating rim/spokes/paddles on the left. Retain the small fixed bronze axle cap and its supporting pale aqua stone. Reveal a clean dark teal recessed wheel cavity and complete the pale aqua stone back wall and flat water beneath the wheel. No floating wheel remnants.
2. Remove the white/cyan falling waterfall curtains from both central stone steps and from beside the wheel. Reveal the rounded pale aqua stone spillway beds, painted in the SAME original geometry. The upper little pool and lower large pool remain filled with plain smooth turquoise water at the original water levels.
3. Remove floating foam, splash crowns, droplets, concentric ripple rings, and bright moving ring-shaped highlights from the pool interiors. Fill with restrained smooth aqua/teal water shading. Keep the outer pool rim and all stone outlines.
This is a fully painted, usable underlayer for a layered rig. Complete formerly hidden surfaces, not transparent holes. No missing masonry, no white holes, no empty cutouts inside the nest. Do NOT redesign, move, shrink, enlarge, relight or rotate any fixed structure. Do not add waterwheel fragments or splash effects. Do not create a sheet or diagram. No text. Transparent RGBA background outside the single object.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE production texture atlas of independently riggable parts for the supplied level-3 water nest. The reference defines exact material colors, painterly outlines and shading. These are source attachments in ONE neutral bind pose, NOT sequential animation frames and NOT nine versions of the nest.
Make a transparent square atlas with EXACTLY 3 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells, nine isolated parts, one centered in each cell with at least 12% transparent padding. No labels, numbers, borders, checkerboard, opaque backdrop, shadows outside each part or extra elements. Each part is whole, cleanly isolated on true alpha, never touching a cell edge. Warm golden-brown rounded handmade wood and luminous cyan/turquoise water match the reference.
READING ORDER / EXACT CONTENTS:
Cell 1 top left: a COMPLETE wooden waterwheel FRONT FACE, viewed perfectly straight on as a true circle for later mesh projection: slim golden wooden outer circular rim, six simple thick wooden spokes connecting the rim to a small central round hub. Smooth solid warm wood, clean dark-brown outlines, soft upper-left lighting, transparent open gaps between spokes. No paddles, axle, supports, stones or water. Entire circle visible.
Cell 2 top center: the matching COMPLETE BACK FACE ring and six spokes, same circle dimensions and structure, shaded slightly darker warm brown to expose the rear side in a rig. No paddles, supports or water.
Cell 3 top right: ONE complete paddle plank FRONT texture, a broad horizontal rectangular golden wooden board with softly rounded corners, a clear slightly lighter upper edge and dark lower edge, subtle grain and reference-style outline. Face-on flat source texture, no dramatic perspective. Width about 3 times height. No attachments.
Cell 4 middle left: the matching BACK / underside of that same paddle plank, same exact rectangular proportions, dark amber brown with a narrow golden edge, complete unoccluded surface.
Cell 5 middle center: ONE vertical WATERFALL ribbon source texture, 2.5 times taller than wide. Smooth translucent deep aqua curtain with several slender bright cyan-white falling streaks, gentle irregular flowing side contours, no stone, no pool, no foam crown at either end, no detached droplets. Clean top and bottom suitable for masked scrolling and a continuous connected waterfall.
Cell 6 middle right: ONE small low WATER SPLASH CROWN source attachment, three modest curved translucent aqua-white foam lobes rising from a short shallow curved waterline, broad rather than tall, no stones, no pool, no detached droplets. It will be deformed locally and combined with separate moving droplets.
Cell 7 bottom left: ONE broad, thin horizontal elliptical RIPPLE RING attachment. Hand-painted cyan-white broken arcs, mostly transparent interior, right and left thin fade, a few tiny interruptions, not a thick neon torus. Width 3 times height.
Cell 8 bottom middle: ONE smaller upper-pool REFLECTION CRESCENT / almost elliptical thin ripple arc, soft aqua-white painterly highlight, mostly transparent, low horizontal ellipse, no opaque blue interior.
Cell 9 bottom right: ONE tiny standalone luminous turquoise WATER DROPLET, rounded teardrop with a short curved tip and one crisp white highlight, no splash crown or trail. Complete transparent silhouette, reference art style.
All nine attachments will be reused, rotated, deformed, scaled or translated by a layered rig. Fully paint hidden/back surfaces where requested. Do not produce whole nests or a motion contact sheet.
